body:
Follow-up to `simdesign-pocketmesh` (track 5): scans web width on 1.5, 1.0, 0.75 and 0.5 mm meshes. No feasible width at 1.0 and 0.5 mm; one point at 0.75 mm; lowest peak stress rises 11–14%. Usable window capped at w = 16.0 mm by the slenderness rule (documented). 6 tests pass, `python site/build.py` ok, README and site entry added.
